{{Top|canon=Squad leader}}
'''Squadron Leader''' was a positional title within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Flight Branch]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The title was appended to the [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|ranks]] of [[TIE pilot]]s in the [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] who were in command of [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]].

[[Stevan Makintay]] served as the Squadron Leader for [[Eyrie Base]]'s [[Green Squadron (Eyrie Base)|Green Squadron]].<ref name="Firepower">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower}}</ref>

The title was also used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]].<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>
